title: saare jaha ka hadi rehbar guzar gaya
body:
Haay mola naqi (as) haay mola naqi (as).
saare jaha ka hadi rehbar guzar gaya.
hai samere me ghul yeh wali guzar gaya.
1) Zahere e dagha diya hai zalim ne tujhko aise.
Tera jigar zaher se haaye chaak hogaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
2)Gash me hai Askari (as) ab gham me hai yeh zamana.
Deene nabi jagaakar hadi (as) guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
3) is teesri rajab ko gham ka pahad toota.
Be jurm haay moula deen ka guzar gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
4) rouza gira jo tera ay dilabare samana (as).
Hai doosri shahadat Mehdi (as) tadap gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) jo zulm ho rahe hai ab Shaam o Samere mai.
Ruk jaye behre dawar banjaye baqaiyya.
<<DIVIDER>>
6) koun o makaan hai larza is gham se haay baqir.
Askar swt ke sar se saaya baba ka uth gaya.
